_source: Lucid Trading — LucidFlex evaluation, 25K. Rules read 2026-10-29; confirm on your dashboard after any firm update.

drawdown.basis: end-of-day balance high-water mark — intraday excursions do not count

consistency.applies_to: evaluation only; the rule is dropped once funded
consistency.formula: largest single day profit / account profit must be at or below the limit

desk.book: two ES daily rules, one micro each: nday_fade-5 0.5A tp1 + nr_break-2 1.0A tp1
desk.why: Chosen by atr_grid.py, which walked $25,000 through every rule x stop x exit x market from every starting trade. This pair passes 88% of attempts with the 40% consistency rule intact and breaches the floor in 7%; a median session risks $405, both legs stopping costs about $618, so the $1,000 buffer holds two bad sessions. It is ES on purpose: one micro of NQ at a 1.0 ATR stop risks $1,054, which is the whole buffer in a single trade, and every NQ line on a 25K fails the consistency rule because one good day is more than 40% of the $1,250 target.

plan.next: when the 25K account has banked its cushion, either buy a 50K or fund the same 25K to +$2,000 of cushion before adding risk
plan.why: 50K is the smallest LucidFlex account that holds the wider-stop books (2.0-2.5 ATR) and the NQ lines at two micros; on a 25K those stops are one trade away from a breach, so they win more often and pass less often.
